verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אִיִּים֙ אֵלַ֔י וְהַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ לְאֻמִּ֖ים מֵרָח֑וֹק יְהוָה֙ מִבֶּ֣טֶן קְרָאָ֔נִי מִמְּעֵ֥י אִמִּ֖י הִזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’î·yîm ’ê·lay wə·haq·šî·ḇū lə·’um·mîm mê·rā·ḥō·wq Yah·weh mib·be·ṭen qə·rā·’ā·nî mim·mə·‘ê ’im·mî hiz·kîr šə·mî
verses.literal: Listen to Me O islands pay attention O distant peoples The LORD called Me from the womb from the body of My mother He named Me . . .

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם פִּי֙ כְּחֶ֣רֶב חַדָּ֔ה בְּצֵ֥ל יָד֖וֹ הֶחְבִּיאָ֑נִי וַיְשִׂימֵ֙נִי֙ לְחֵ֣ץ בָּר֔וּר בְּאַשְׁפָּת֖וֹ הִסְתִּירָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem pî kə·ḥe·reḇ ḥad·dāh bə·ṣêl yā·ḏōw heḥ·bî·’ā·nî way·śî·mê·nî lə·ḥêṣ bā·rūr bə·’aš·pā·ṯōw his·tî·rā·nî
verses.literal: He made My mouth like a sharp sword He hid Me in the shadow of His hand He made Me like a polished arrow He hid Me in His quiver

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֖י עַבְדִּי־ אָ֑תָּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֕ל אֲשֶׁר־ בְּךָ֖ אֶתְפָּאָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lî ‘aḇ·dî- ’āt·tāh yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- bə·ḵā ’eṯ·pā·’ār
verses.literal: He said to Me You are My Servant Israel in whom I will display My glory

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ לְרִ֣יק יָגַ֔עְתִּי לְתֹ֥הוּ וְהֶ֖בֶל כֹּחִ֣י כִלֵּ֑יתִי אָכֵן֙ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וּפְעֻלָּתִ֖י אֶת־ אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî lə·rîq yā·ḡa‘·tî lə·ṯō·hū wə·he·ḇel kō·ḥî ḵil·lê·ṯî ’ā·ḵên miš·pā·ṭî ’eṯ- Yah·weh ū·p̄ə·‘ul·lā·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: But I said I have labored in vain I have spent My strength in futility and vanity yet My vindication is with the LORD and My reward is with My God

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יֹצְרִ֤י מִבֶּ֙טֶן֙ לְעֶ֣בֶד ל֔וֹ לְשׁוֹבֵ֤ב יַֽעֲקֹב֙ אֵלָ֔יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא יֵאָסֵ֑ף וְאֶכָּבֵד֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וֵאלֹהַ֖י הָיָ֥ה עֻזִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ā·mar Yah·weh yō·ṣə·rî mib·be·ṭen lə·‘e·ḇeḏ lōw lə·šō·w·ḇêḇ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ê·lāw wə·yiś·rā·’êl lō yê·’ā·sêp̄ wə·’ek·kā·ḇêḏ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh wê·lō·hay hā·yāh ‘uz·zî
verses.literal: And now says the LORD who formed Me from the womb to be His Servant to bring Jacob back to Him that Israel . . . might be gathered to Him for I am honored in the sight of the LORD and My God is My strength

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָקֵ֨ל מִֽהְיוֹתְךָ֥ לִי֙ עֶ֔בֶד לְהָקִים֙ אֶת־ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּנְצִירֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהָשִׁ֑יב וּנְתַתִּ֙יךָ֙ לְא֣וֹר גּוֹיִ֔ם לִֽהְי֥וֹת יְשׁוּעָתִ֖י עַד־ קְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nā·qêl mih·yō·wṯ·ḵā lî ‘e·ḇeḏ lə·hā·qîm ’eṯ- šiḇ·ṭê ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·nə·ṣī·rē yiś·rā·’êl lə·hā·šîḇ ū·nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·’ō·wr gō·w·yim lih·yō·wṯ yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He says It is not enough for You to be My Servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to restore the protected ones of Israel I will also make You a light for the nations to bring My salvation to the ends of the earth

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָֽמַר־ יְהוָה֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קְדוֹשׁ֗וֹ לִבְזֹה־ נֶ֜פֶשׁ לִמְתָ֤עֵֽב גּוֹי֙ לְעֶ֣בֶד מֹשְׁלִ֔ים מְלָכִים֙ יִרְא֣וּ וָקָ֔מוּ שָׂרִ֖ים וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֑וּ לְמַ֤עַן יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֶאֱמָ֔ן קְדֹ֥שׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיִּבְחָרֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar- Yah·weh gō·’êl yiś·rā·’êl qə·ḏō·wō·šōw liḇ·zōh- ne·p̄eš lim·ṯā·‘êḇ gō·w lə·‘e·ḇeḏ mō·šə·lîm mə·lā·ḵîm yir·’ū wā·qā·mū śā·rîm wə·yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū lə·ma·‘an Yah·weh ’ă·šer ne·’ĕ·mān qə·ḏōš yiś·rā·’êl way·yiḇ·ḥā·re·kā
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel to Him who was despised and abhorred by the nation to the Servant of rulers Kings will see You and rise and princes will bow down because of the LORD who is faithful the Holy One of Israel who has chosen You

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה בְּעֵ֤ת רָצוֹן֙ עֲנִיתִ֔יךָ וּבְי֥וֹם יְשׁוּעָ֖ה עֲזַרְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֶצָּרְךָ֗ וְאֶתֶּנְךָ֙ לִבְרִ֣ית עָ֔ם לְהָקִ֣ים אֶ֔רֶץ לְהַנְחִ֖יל נְחָל֥וֹת שֹׁמֵמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh bə·‘êṯ rā·ṣō·wn ‘ă·nî·ṯî·ḵā ū·ḇə·yō·wm yə·šū·‘āh ‘ă·zar·tî·ḵā wə·’eṣ·ṣā·rə·ḵā wə·’et·ten·ḵā liḇ·rîṯ ‘ām lə·hā·qîm ’e·reṣ lə·han·ḥîl nə·ḥā·lō·wṯ šō·mê·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says In the time of favor I will answer You and in the day of salvation I will help You I will keep You and appoint You to be a covenant for the people to restore the land to apportion its desolate inheritances

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֤ר לַֽאֲסוּרִים֙ צֵ֔אוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּחֹ֖שֶׁךְ הִגָּל֑וּ עַל־ דְּרָכִ֣ים יִרְע֔וּ וּבְכָל־ שְׁפָיִ֖ים מַרְעִיתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lê·mōr la·’ă·sū·rîm ṣê·’ū la·’ă·šer ba·ḥō·šeḵ hig·gā·lū ‘al- də·rā·ḵîm yir·‘ū ū·ḇə·ḵāl šə·p̄ā·yîm mar·‘î·ṯām
verses.literal: to say to the prisoners Come out and to those in darkness Show yourselves They will feed along the pathways and find pasture on every barren hill

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִרְעָ֙בוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִצְמָ֔אוּ וְלֹא־ יַכֵּ֥ם שָׁרָ֖ב וָשָׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּי־ מְרַחֲמָ֣ם יְנַהֲגֵ֔ם וְעַל־ מַבּ֥וּעֵי מַ֖יִם יְנַהֲלֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō yir·‘ā·ḇū wə·lō yiṣ·mā·’ū wə·lō- yak·kêm šā·rāḇ wā·šā·meš kî- mə·ra·ḥă·mām yə·na·hă·ḡêm wə·‘al- mab·bū·‘ê ma·yim yə·na·hă·lêm
verses.literal: They will not hunger or thirst nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י כָל־ הָרַ֖י לַדָּ֑רֶךְ וּמְסִלֹּתַ֖י יְרֻמֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî ḵāl hā·ray lad·dā·reḵ ū·mə·sil·lō·ṯay yə·ru·mūn
verses.literal: I will turn all My mountains into roads and My highways will be raised up

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ אֵ֕לֶּה מֵרָח֖וֹק יָבֹ֑אוּ וְהִֽנֵּה־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ מִצָּפ֣וֹן וּמִיָּ֔ם וְאֵ֖לֶּה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ סִינִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- ’êl·leh mê·rā·ḥō·wq yā·ḇō·’ū wə·hin·nêh- ’êl·leh miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ū·mî·yām wə·’êl·leh mê·’e·reṣ sî·nîm
verses.literal: Behold they will come from far away . . . . . . from the north and from the west and from the land of Aswan

verses.original: רָנּ֤וּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְגִ֣ילִי אָ֔רֶץ יִפְצְחוּ הָרִ֖ים רִנָּ֑ה כִּֽי־ נִחַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ וַעֲנִיָּ֖ו יְרַחֵֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: rān·nū šā·ma·yim wə·ḡî·lî ’ā·reṣ yip̄·ṣə·ḥū hā·rîm rin·nāh kî- ni·ḥam Yah·weh ‘am·mōw wa·‘ă·nî·yāw yə·ra·ḥêm
verses.literal: Shout for joy O heavens rejoice O earth break forth in song O mountains For the LORD has comforted His people and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones

verses.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר צִיּ֖וֹן עֲזָבַ֣נִי יְהוָ֑ה וַאדֹנָ֖י שְׁכֵחָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ṣî·yō·wn ‘ă·zā·ḇa·nî Yah·weh wa·ḏō·nāy šə·ḵê·ḥā·nî
verses.literal: But Zion said The LORD has forsaken me the Lord has forgotten me

verses.original: הֲתִשְׁכַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ עוּלָ֔הּ מֵרַחֵ֖ם בֶּן־ בִּטְנָ֑הּ גַּם־ אֵ֣לֶּה תִשְׁכַּ֔חְנָה וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א אֶשְׁכָּחֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯiš·kaḥ ’iš·šāh ‘ū·lāh mê·ra·ḥêm ben- biṭ·nāh gam- ’êl·leh ṯiš·kaḥ·nāh wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō ’eš·kā·ḥêḵ
verses.literal: Can a woman forget her nursing child or lack compassion for the son of her womb Even if she could forget I will not forget you

verses.original: הֵ֥ן עַל־ כַּפַּ֖יִם חַקֹּתִ֑יךְ חוֹמֹתַ֥יִךְ נֶגְדִּ֖י תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: hên ‘al- kap·pa·yim ḥaq·qō·ṯîḵ ḥō·w·mō·ṯa·yiḵ neḡ·dî tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: Behold I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands your walls are ever before Me

verses.original: מִֽהֲר֖וּ בָּנָ֑יִךְ מְהָֽרְסַ֥יִךְ וּמַחֲרִבַ֖יִךְ מִמֵּ֥ךְ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mi·hă·rū bā·nā·yiḵ mə·hā·rə·sa·yiḵ ū·ma·ḥă·ri·ḇa·yiḵ mim·mêḵ yê·ṣê·’ū
verses.literal: Your builders hasten back your destroyers and wreckers depart from you

verses.original: שְׂאִֽי־ סָבִ֤יב עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ וּרְאִ֔י כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ בָֽאוּ־ לָ֑ךְ חַי־ אָ֣נִי נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י כֻלָּם֙ כָּעֲדִ֣י תִלְבָּ֔שִׁי וּֽתְקַשְּׁרִ֖ים כַּכַּלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śə·’î- sā·ḇîḇ ‘ê·na·yiḵ ū·rə·’î kul·lām niq·bə·ṣū ḇā·’ū- lāḵ ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh kî ḵul·lām kā·‘ă·ḏî ṯil·bā·šî ū·ṯə·qaš·šə·rîm kak·kal·lāh
verses.literal: Lift up your eyes and look around They all gather together they come to you As surely as I live declares the LORD you will wear them all as jewelry and put them on like a bride

verses.original: כִּ֤י חָרְבֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְשֹׁ֣מְמֹתַ֔יִךְ וְאֶ֖רֶץ הֲרִֽסֻתֵ֑יךְ כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ תֵּצְרִ֣י מִיּוֹשֵׁ֔ב וְרָחֲק֖וּ מְבַלְּעָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥā·rə·ḇō·ṯa·yiḵ wə·šō·mə·mō·ṯa·yiḵ wə·’e·reṣ hă·ri·su·ṯêḵ kî ‘at·tāh tê·ṣə·rî mî·yō·wō·šêḇ wə·rā·ḥă·qū mə·ḇal·lə·‘ā·yiḵ
verses.literal: For your ruined and desolate places and your ravaged land . . . will now indeed be too small for your people and those who devoured you will be far away

verses.original: ע֚וֹד יֹאמְר֣וּ בְאָזְנַ֔יִךְ בְּנֵ֖י שִׁכֻּלָ֑יִךְ צַר־ לִ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם גְּשָׁה־ לִּ֥י וְאֵשֵֽׁבָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wḏ yō·mə·rū ḇə·’ā·zə·na·yiḵ bə·nê šik·ku·lā·yiḵ ṣar- lî ham·mā·qō·wm gə·šāh- lî wə·’ê·šê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Yet the children of your bereavement will say in your hearing This place is too small for us make room for us to live here

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣רְתְּ בִּלְבָבֵ֗ךְ מִ֤י יָֽלַד־ לִי֙ אֶת־ אֵ֔לֶּה וַאֲנִ֥י שְׁכוּלָ֖ה וְגַלְמוּדָ֑ה גֹּלָ֣ה׀ וְסוּרָ֗ה וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ מִ֣י גִדֵּ֔ל הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י אֵ֖לֶּה אֵיפֹ֥ה הֵֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mart bil·ḇā·ḇêḵ mî yā·laḏ- lî ’eṯ- ’êl·leh wa·’ă·nî šə·ḵū·lāh wə·ḡal·mū·ḏāh gō·lāh wə·sū·rāh wə·’êl·leh mî ḡid·dêl hên ’ă·nî niš·’ar·tî lə·ḇad·dî ’êl·leh ’ê·p̄ōh hêm
verses.literal: Then you will say in your heart Who has begotten these for me I was bereaved and barren I was exiled and rejected So who has reared them Look I was left all alone so where did they come from

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אֶשָּׂ֤א אֶל־ גּוֹיִם֙ יָדִ֔י וְאֶל־ עַמִּ֖ים אָרִ֣ים נִסִּ֑י וְהֵבִ֤יאוּ בָנַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּחֹ֔צֶן וּבְנֹתַ֖יִךְ עַל־ כָּתֵ֥ף תִּנָּשֶֽׂאנָה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nêh ’eś·śā ’el- gō·w·yim yā·ḏî wə·’el- ‘am·mîm ’ā·rîm nis·sî wə·hê·ḇî·’ū ḇā·na·yiḵ bə·ḥō·ṣen ū·ḇə·nō·ṯa·yiḵ ‘al- kā·ṯêp̄ tin·nā·śe·nāh
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says Behold I will lift up My hand to the nations and raise My banner to the peoples They will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ מְלָכִ֜ים אֹֽמְנַ֗יִךְ וְשָׂרֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ מֵינִ֣יקֹתַ֔יִךְ אַפַּ֗יִם אֶ֚רֶץ יִשְׁתַּ֣חֲווּ לָ֔ךְ וַעֲפַ֥ר רַגְלַ֖יִךְ יְלַחֵ֑כוּ וְיָדַ֙עַתְּ֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ קוָֹֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū mə·lā·ḵîm ’ō·mə·na·yiḵ wə·śā·rō·w·ṯê·hem mê·nî·qō·ṯa·yiḵ ’ap·pa·yim ’e·reṣ yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lāḵ wa·‘ă·p̄ar raḡ·la·yiḵ yə·la·ḥê·ḵū wə·yā·ḏa·‘at kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ă·šer lō- yê·ḇō·šū qō·wāy
verses.literal: Kings will be your foster fathers and their queens your nursing mothers They will bow to you facedown . . . and lick the dust at your feet Then you will know that I am the LORD those who hope in Me will never be put to shame

verses.original: הֲיֻקַּ֥ח מִגִּבּ֖וֹר מַלְק֑וֹחַ וְאִם־ שְׁבִ֥י צַדִּ֖יק יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yuq·qaḥ mig·gib·bō·wr mal·qō·w·aḥ wə·’im- šə·ḇî ṣad·dîq yim·mā·lêṭ
verses.literal: Can the plunder be snatched from the mighty or the captives of a tyrant be delivered

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה גַּם־ שְׁבִ֤י גִבּוֹר֙ יֻקָּ֔ח וּמַלְק֥וֹחַ עָרִ֖יץ יִמָּלֵ֑ט וְאֶת־ יְרִיבֵךְ֙ אָנֹכִ֣י אָרִ֔יב וְאֶת־ בָּנַ֖יִךְ אָנֹכִ֥י אוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh gam- šə·ḇî ḡib·bō·wr yuq·qāḥ ū·mal·qō·w·aḥ ‘ā·rîṣ yim·mā·lêṭ wə·’eṯ- yə·rî·ḇêḵ ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·rîḇ wə·’eṯ- bā·na·yiḵ ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Indeed this is what the LORD says Even the captives of the mighty will be taken away and the plunder of the tyrant will be retrieved I will contend with those who contend with you and I will save your children

verses.original: וְהַאֲכַלְתִּ֤י אֶת־ מוֹנַ֙יִךְ֙ אֶת־ בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְכֶעָסִ֖יס דָּמָ֣ם יִשְׁכָּר֑וּן וְיָדְע֣וּ כָל־ בָּשָׂ֗ר כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔ךְ וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·’ă·ḵal·tî ’eṯ- mō·w·na·yiḵ ’eṯ- bə·śā·rām wə·ḵe·‘ā·sîs dā·mām yiš·kā·rūn wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū ḵāl bā·śār kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mō·wō·šî·‘êḵ wə·ḡō·’ă·lêḵ ’ă·ḇîr ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh they will be drunk on their own blood as with wine Then all mankind will know that I the LORD am your Savior and your Redeemer the Mighty One of Jacob
